title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Crediting a Booked Visit That Was Never Performed
content:
## Service coordinator desk entry

Where a visit booked under a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record was never performed, the building owner is credited for it. The credit is tied to the work order the visit was booked under, set against the invoice the owner is to take it off, stamped with the current billing month, and lowers the amount the owner owes under the agreement by the amount credited.

### How the credit is booked

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `issue_visit_credit_1d93f422` and calls it. One call books a single credit of that kind against the named agreement.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the preventive maintenance agreement record the credit is booked against | an identifier, read from the maintenance agreement lookup before the call |
| `work_order_ref` | the work order number the unperformed visit was booked under, copied from the booking entry in the agreement's history | `WO-` followed by 7 digits |
| `invoice_ref` | the invoice number the credit is set against, copied from the instalment entry it is to be taken off in the agreement's history | `INV-` followed by 8 digits |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the money amount credited | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent; an amount of zero is accepted and books a zero credit |

### Return

The call returns a one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the credit entry created, the agreement it was booked against, the work order it was tied to, the invoice it was set against and the amount credited in USD to two decimal places. That line is issued only when the credit has been written and the agreement's outstanding balance has been lowered; it is the receipt of completion.

### Observable effect

Afterwards the credit appears in the agreement's history and the agreement's outstanding balance is lower by exactly the amount credited.
